name: Full Moon Blaster
main_effect: [Main] Return 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon to its owner's hand. If your opponent has 8 or more cards in their hand, instead return 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
